title: OpenDCAI/DataFlow turns noisy source material into AI-ready data pipelines
friendlyTitle: DataFlow helps clean and prepare data for AI
summary: DataFlow is an Apache-2.0 Python system for generating, refining, evaluating and filtering data for model training and RAG. It was among the day’s strongest AI-related GitHub Trending projects and had about 7,000 stars when checked.
friendlySummary: This popular Python project turns messy documents and question-answer data into better material for RAG and model training.
whyItMatters: Use its operators and pipelines to turn PDFs, plain text or low-quality question-answer sets into cleaner domain data. It is particularly relevant when a RAG system or fine-tuned model is limited by data quality rather than model choice.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when your AI system has poor or messy source data. Its pipelines can clean, filter and check that data before you train a model or build RAG.
